scope: Eight finite model groups. No source headline theorem, infinite-dimensional limit or Lean proof certified.

annulus_factorization.scope: finite factorization and preimage identity only

commuting_taylor.scope: diagonal common-spectral models; global envelope assumed

evaluation_surjection.scope: coordinate normers and residual-halving surjection; not the infinite-dimensional criterion

small_restriction.scope: compact diagonal examples, not a finite test for strict singularity

laguerre_flux.scope: quadratic identity and disk algebra, not rapid tail decay

neutral_stable_graph.scope: finite backward boundary model, no PDE or infinite-horizon proof
